description: A very calm heather landscape with fens surrounded by mixed forest on a winter day in February. National Park Kampina in the south of the Netherlands. It's wonderfully quiet here. More here today / More recordings here during the year's Birds: European Robin, Common Chaffinch, Eurasian Blue Tit, Great Spotted Woodpeacker, Great Tit, Crested Tit, Canada Goose, Eurasian Blackbird, Eurasian Wren and Shored-toed Treecreeper In the background a train and very far traffic.
